decision.status: accepted architecture; implementation and evidence pending

provenance.generator: deterministic profile projection from the pinned parent profile and repository research; no build.rs or runtime discovery
provenance.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with stable schema-key order, parent feature order, and lexical case/capability order
provenance.reproducibility: Re-run the static validation in compat/capability-sets/README.md; any parent-profile byte or identity change invalidates this projection until regenerated and reviewed.

claim_policy.promotion_requires: Update the parent profile status and evidence reference only after every profile-required oracle, adapter, and test gate passes.
claim_policy.native_case_meaning: The current Rust tree contains a bounded implementation boundary for the named case. It is not proof of JMeter 5.6.3 conformance and does not promote its parent row.
claim_policy.optional_pack_case_meaning: The exact case is delegated to an explicitly selected, identity-checked compatibility pack. The pack is not provisioned by this projection and is never an implicit fallback.
claim_policy.unavailable_case_meaning: The current standalone product rejects the named case with a typed capability boundary or defers it. A plan containing it must not execute a native prefix.

standalone_constraints.admission: whole-plan atomic classification before setup, I/O, process creation, script evaluation, listener publication, or output publication
standalone_constraints.unknown_jmx: bounded unknown and external subtrees remain loadable, inspectable, and saveable; execution is a separate capability decision

ordering.cases: sorted in parent profile feature order, then by case_id ascending
ordering.object_keys: written in this stable schema order; consumers must not use object order as meaning

evidence_requirements.description: Run the parent feature's exact pinned JMeter 5.6.3 fixture and compare the declared observable fields using every referenced normalization policy.
Deterministic unit, property, fuzz, state-machine, or local integration evidence at the lowest useful Rust boundary, including negative and resource-limit paths.
Run in an isolated environment with no Java executable, JAVA_HOME, JMeter home, classpath, plugin directory, or helper files; trace that no JVM/helper process is discovered or spawned.

Verify the signed pinned compatibility-pack artifact, helper, Java runtime, ordered classpath, provider/plugin identities, bridge limits, cancellation, crash, and exact differential fixture before useful work.
Exercise the stable unsupported-capability result, source location, no-side-effect admission, and lossless preservation requirements for the unavailable case.
evidence_requirements.source: Decision 0009 acceptance gates and architecture section 8

evidence_requirements.description: Keep GUI-001..003 in the parent profile, preserve GUI-authored JMX headlessly, and prove GUI invocation fails closed without opening a partial editor or starting a run.
Build and inspect the one-executable release boundary for each declared target; cross-compilation is not native-runtime evidence.
